tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Finite-measure unbounded domains] 1. ch8:8.9\group ch08-generalized-solutions The existence and uniqueness conclusion of Theorem 8.3 remains valid when $\Omega $ is unbounded but has finite measure.
Proof

\sketch Theorem 8.16 supplies the a priori control needed to replace the compact embedding used in the bounded-domain Fredholm proof. Exhaust $\Omega $ by bounded subdomains, solve there, and pass to a weak limit; the maximum principle gives uniqueness.

□
